title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
composition_pd_basis: Lyrics: Jane Taylor, Rhymes for the Nursery (1806). Melody: Ah! vous dirai-je maman (1761). Published well before 1930; 95-year term expired.
notes: Shares melody with Baa Baa Black Sheep and the Alphabet Song. Vary arrangement between uses.

title: The Itsy Bitsy Spider
composition_pd_basis: Traditional American; printed in pre-1930 collections. 95-year term expired.

title: Old MacDonald Had a Farm
composition_pd_basis: Traditional; printed as 'Ohio' in Tommy's Tunes (1917). 95-year term expired.
notes: Cumulative structure; vary animals between videos.

title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat
composition_pd_basis: Franklin Square Song Collection (1881). 95-year term expired.
notes: Very short; needs scene arc to fill runtime.

title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
composition_pd_basis: Sarah Josepha Hale, Poems for Our Children (1830); melody Lowell Mason (1830s). Term expired.
notes: Narrative rhyme; suits a story arc.

title: Hickory Dickory Dock
composition_pd_basis: Tommy Thumb's Pretty Song Book (c. 1744). Term long expired.
notes: Counting extension to twelve; good numeracy hook.

title: London Bridge Is Falling Down
composition_pd_basis: Gammer Gurton's Garland (1784). Term long expired.
notes: Keep visuals constructive: building and mending only.

title: Baa, Baa, Black Sheep
composition_pd_basis: Tommy Thumb's Pretty Song Book (c. 1744). Term long expired.
notes: Shares melody with Twinkle. Do not schedule close together.

title: The Wheels on the Bus
composition_pd_basis: UNVERIFIED. Attributed to Verna Hills, 1939 - would still be in copyright.
notes: DO NOT USE. Feels traditional and is widely treated as free; the attribution is 1939. Needs counsel, not a guess. The pipeline refuses this rhyme.
